newsitem.title: USA: US Treasuries turn positive, wkly retail data weak.
newsitem.headline: US Treasuries turn positive, wkly retail data weak.

text.p: *US Treasuries erase small losses. Redbook retail sales dn 0.2 pct in Jul 12 week. Earlier, June US retail sales up 0.5 pct.
*Treasuries seen confined to range trading ahead of new supply
*Dlr retreats from fresh top, seen mild negative for US assets
*US June CPI due out Wed, seen up 0.2 pct vs May's up 0.1 pct.
